content.thinking: Design a friendly duck crest/bill? Head-top datum on the head shell. Friendly duckling tuft/crest with small rounded feathers (ellipsoids), bilateral. Base ellipse ~16x14x2, feathers tilted back, plus a small round crest puff. No sharp shapes.
